items.name: Mysore silk crepe, kumkum red
items.picAlt: Red Mysore silk with a wide gold zari border of mango motifs
items.desc: Pure silk crepe with a 4-inch gold zari border of mango motifs. Soft enough to drape without starch.
items.care: Dry clean only for the first wash; store wrapped in muslin.

items.name: Navilu hand embroidery on Udupi cotton
items.picAlt: A peacock and flowers embroidered in gold, blue and red thread on ivory cotton
items.desc: Ivory Udupi cotton with a peacock embroidered by hand on the pallu. Eleven days of work for one saree.
items.care: Hand wash cold, inside out; dry in shade.

items.name: Peacock border on sandal tussar
items.picAlt: Close-up of a gold peacock with a blue flower embroidered on sandal-coloured silk
items.desc: Tussar silk in natural sandal with a running peacock border worked in zari thread.

items.name: Ilkal cotton-silk, parrot green
items.desc: Parrot-green body joined by hand to a red tope teni pallu, the three white stripes every Ilkal is known by.
items.care: First wash in salt water to fix the colour; hand wash after.

items.name: Ilkal cotton-silk, black
items.desc: Black body with a red kondi-joined pallu and a narrow gomi border.
items.care: First wash in salt water to fix the colour; hand wash after.

items.name: Ilkal cotton, temple red
items.desc: All-red cotton Ilkal with a bottle-green border. Sold out; the weaver in Ilkal takes about three weeks for another.

items.name: Molakalmuru silk, peacock blue
items.desc: Heavy silk with a gold temple border and a pallu of small rui phool flowers.
items.care: Dry clean only; refold every three months.

items.name: Molakalmuru silk, mango yellow
items.desc: Mango-yellow body with a parrot-green border and pallu, a classic pair for weddings.

items.name: Mysore silk crepe, bottle green
items.desc: Deep green crepe with a slim zari border and a plain gold pallu.

items.name: Mysore silk, mint with plain zari
items.desc: A lighter Mysore silk for office days, with a half-inch zari border.

items.name: Udupi cotton, indigo checks
items.desc: Handloom cotton in small indigo checks with a red border. Gets softer with every wash.

items.name: Udupi cotton, white and red
items.desc: White body, red border and a red pallu: the Udupi saree most grandmothers wore.

items.name: Udupi cotton, mustard
items.desc: Mustard body with an ink-blue border, light enough for May.

items.name: Cotton kurta, sandalwood buttons
items.picAlt: An ivory cotton kurta with a narrow placket and small wooden buttons
items.desc: Ivory handloom kurta with sandalwood buttons, cut long for men. Sizes 38 to 46.
items.care: Machine wash cold; iron while damp.
